October 22, 2018 - By Dolores Ford

Art Advsr Ltd Limited Liability Company invested in 0.26% or 108,100 shares. Mackay Shields Ltd Llc reported 28,059 shares stake.
Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc increased its stake in T (TMUS) by 138.8% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc bought 177,525 shares as the company’s stock rose 15.75% with the market. The institutional investor held 305,425 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $18.25 million, up from 127,900 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc who had been investing in T for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $59.09B market cap company. The stock increased 1.43% or $0.98 during the last trading session, reaching $69.75. About 4.71M shares traded or 48.70% up from the average. T-Mobile US, Inc. (NYSE:TMUS) has risen 7.84% since October 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.78% the S&P500.
Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc, which manages about $7.55 billion and $2.67B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 72,078 shares to 101,599 shares, valued at $18.81 million in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Merck & Co. Inc. (NYSE:MRK) by 110,025 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 386,312 shares, and cut its stake in Pulte Homes Inc. (NYSE:PHM).
